_comment: What a one-shot Shift tap makes of the next character. A character listed in results is replaced by its result; the magic key, whose character the user chooses, gives magic_key_result, before any result its character has; any other character is typed in title case (é gives É, 1 stays 1). Windows (TapHoldOneShotResult in platform/remap/tap_hold_loader.ahk), Linux (platform/remap/tap_hold_manager.lua), and macOS (adapters/one_shot_shift.lua) read this file.
